name: color
meaning: 24-bit RGB tint; passed through Color_RgbToBgr (which also zeroes the alpha byte) into all four vertex colours

name: u
meaning: U origin of the sub-rect within the 256-pixel texture page

name: wMinus1
meaning: sub-rect width minus 1 in texels; used as both the offset and the size argument of Tex_CornerUV on the U axis

name: drawFlags
meaning: flag word whose bits 6..8 (mask 0x01C0) hold a 0..7 fade/alpha level set by UiIcon_SetFadeLevel; not read by UiQuad_Draw itself, so the consumer is elsewhere in the interface module

name: texIndex
meaning: texture/poly index passed as Draw2D_TexRect's texIndex argument (the same space as RenderPoly.type minus 4)

name: x
meaning: left edge in the 512x240 virtual HUD space, fed to Screen_ScaleX

name: y
meaning: top edge in virtual HUD space, fed to Screen_ScaleY

name: w
meaning: width in virtual HUD units; x1 = x + w. Made negative by UiQuad_Mirror to flip horizontally

name: h
meaning: height in virtual HUD units; y1 = y + h. Made negative by UiQuad_Mirror to flip vertically
